terra.problem: The text does not say the olive-tree vision happened on a different night.
The horses are described as strong, but the text does not say none was tired or hoping not to be noticed.
The text says Zechariah asks the angel, but does not say he stays put or that he does not follow the chariots.
Zechariah 5:11 describes building a house in Shinar, not a house already built.
The passage does not say the horses rush past one another.
The passage is the sixth in the story group, but that does not establish that Zechariah had six visions.
Referring to visions 'in this group' exposes the lesson's organization.
